title: EgoPhys: Physics-Informed Digital Twins for Deformable Objects from Egocentric Video
abstract: arXiv:2606.16202v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Humans naturally understand object physics through everyday interactions, but predicting how deformable objects, such as soft objects and fabrics, respond to manipulation remains a major challenge for computer vision and robotics. Existing deformable physical twin methods typically rely on controlled multi-view or depth capture and costly per-object physical refinement. We present EgoPhys, a framework for constructing predictive deformable physical twins from a single egocentric RGB interaction. EgoPhys combines persistent correspondences with per-frame monocular 3D observations to fit a sequence-specific spring-mass model from moving-camera observations. Because a short interaction weakly constrains fine-grained local stiffness, EgoPhys amortizes this refinement across training interactions using a compact state-conditioned residual model that predicts bounded local corrections around the sequence-specific estimate and remains

translated_title: EgoPhys：基于第一人称视角视频的可变形物体物理信息数字孪生
translated_abstract: 人类通过日常交互自然而然地理解物体物理特性，但预测可变形物体（如软性物体和织物）如何响应操作，对计算机视觉和机器人技术而言仍是一个重大挑战。现有的可变形物理孪生方法通常依赖于受控的多视角或深度采集，以及代价高昂的逐物体物理优化。我们提出了EgoPhys，一个仅需单段第一人称视角RGB交互即可构建预测性可变形物理孪生的框架。EgoPhys将持久对应关系与逐帧单目3D观测相结合，从移动相机的观测中拟合针对特定序列的弹簧-质量模型。由于短暂的交互对细粒度局部刚度的约束较弱，EgoPhys通过一个紧凑的状态条件残差模型在多次训练交互中摊销这一细化过程，该模型在特定序列估计的基础上预测有界的局部校正，并且仍然……
tldr: 提出EgoPhys框架，仅凭单段第一人称视角RGB交互视频即可为可变形物体构建预测性物理数字孪生，无需多视角采集或高昂的逐物体物理优化。
en_tdlr: EgoPhys constructs predictive deformable physical twins from a single egocentric RGB interaction, eliminating the need for controlled multi-view capture or costly per-object physical refinement.
